usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and Imagine.art turns text into artwork through “Text to Image”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Text to Image” in Imagine.art
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can start an image made from text.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so any image action on it runs after a scheduled check.
